concept_summary: A young pianist walks through a rain-soaked city at night, revisiting locations tied to a lost relationship. Memory and present interweave through dissolves and parallel editing, with a piano motif serving as both diegetic element and emotional anchor. The bridge marks a turning point from grief to acceptance as dawn breaks.

color_palette.color_shift_strategy: Cool blue dominance in verses, warm amber intrusion during choruses, gradual warm takeover through bridge to golden dawn in outro.

narrative_thread.premise: A pianist returns to the city where a past relationship ended, spending one night walking through shared memories before finding peace at dawn.
narrative_thread.protagonist: Young male pianist, late 20s, wearing a dark coat, carrying unresolved grief
narrative_thread.conflict: The inability to let go of a relationship that ended, haunted by vivid memories triggered by familiar places
narrative_thread.resolution: At dawn, the protagonist sits at a public piano and plays the nocturne one final time, choosing to let the music carry the memory forward rather than holding onto the pain

cross_cutting_rules: Memory sequences use warmer color grading and softer focus than present-time shots
Never hold a single timeline for more than 20 seconds before cutting to the other
Chorus sections always include at least one present-memory collision moment
The bridge is the only section that stays in a single continuous timeline

section_plans.visual_world: Rain-soaked city at night, empty streets with neon reflections
key_visual_moments: Slow reveal of wet pavement reflecting neon
First piano note triggers the visual world
section_plans.camera_approach: Slow dolly forward through empty street, no character visible yet
section_plans.transition_strategy: Dissolve from wide city to close-up of protagonist's hands on piano keys
section_plans.energy_match: Visual stillness matches low musical energy, slow camera movement builds anticipation

section_plans.visual_world: Night streets, protagonist walking alone past closed shops and empty cafes
key_visual_moments: Protagonist pauses at a cafe window, sees own reflection
section_plans.camera_approach: Handheld medium shots following protagonist, occasional close-ups on face and hands
section_plans.transition_strategy: Accelerating cuts build toward pre-chorus, final shot is protagonist looking up at rain
section_plans.energy_match: Measured pacing matches medium-low energy, camera stays close and intimate

section_plans.visual_world: Split between present rain-soaked streets and warm-toned memory apartment
key_visual_moments: Cross-dissolve from protagonist reaching out to a memory of two hands touching
Rain transforms into golden light particles
section_plans.camera_approach: Dynamic: wide establishing shots intercut with tight emotional close-ups, camera movement follows musical crescendo
section_plans.transition_strategy: Energy drops into verse 2 through a long dissolve from memory back to solitary present
section_plans.energy_match: Full visual crescendo matching high musical energy, fastest cutting pace in the MV

section_plans.visual_world: Memory world: warm apartment interior, golden hour light
key_visual_moments: Intimate domestic scene: cooking together, laughing
A specific object (a music box) that will return in the bridge
section_plans.camera_approach: Steady, warm, intimate framing, shallow depth of field
section_plans.transition_strategy: Rhythmic cuts accelerate as chorus approaches, the warmth begins to fracture
section_plans.energy_match: Gentle pacing matches tender mood, visual warmth contrasts with the melancholy undertone

section_plans.visual_world: Transitional: the boundary between night and dawn, a rooftop or waterfront
key_visual_moments: Protagonist finds the music box in his coat pocket
First light of dawn breaks the horizon
He places the music box on a ledge and walks away
section_plans.camera_approach: Single long take or minimal cuts, camera slowly pulls back to reveal the full scene
section_plans.transition_strategy: Dawn light builds into the final chorus through a camera push-in on the protagonist's face
section_plans.energy_match: Sustained tension matches reflective energy, visual stillness demands attention

section_plans.visual_world: Morning city, same streets now bathed in warm light
key_visual_moments: Protagonist walks the same streets from verse 1, now in morning light
He passes the cafe, this time not stopping
Final wide shot: small figure walking forward into golden light
section_plans.camera_approach: Steady wide shots, gradually pulling back to maximum distance
section_plans.transition_strategy: Slow fade to black over final instrumental bars
section_plans.energy_match: Calm resolution matches fading musical energy, spacious framing conveys emotional release

treatment_notes: The MV uses a non-linear timeline: verse 1 and chorus 1 establish the present-memory pattern, verse 2 deepens the memory world, the bridge provides the turning point, and the outro mirrors verse 1 with transformed emotional context. The piano motif should appear both diegetically (protagonist playing) and as a visual metaphor (keys, notes, sheet music as recurring motifs).
